tasks.prompt: The cookie banner bug is fixed — find that task in the tracker and mark it done. If anything gets in the way, sort it out so the task ends up done.

assertions.name: cookie banner task is done
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id=12

assertions.name: task has an assignee
assertions.sql: SELECT assignee_id FROM tasks WHERE id=12

tasks.prompt: Marcus is completely overloaded. Move every urgent task currently assigned to him over to Sara.

assertions.name: all three urgent tasks now belong to Sara
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE id IN (1,3,5) AND assignee_id=4

assertions.name: Marcus has no urgent tasks left
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE assignee_id=2 AND priority='urgent'

assertions.name: Sara has exactly her 2 originals plus the 3 moved tasks
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE assignee_id=4

tasks.prompt: Open a new high-priority task in the Data Platform project: title 'Backfill missing order events', description 'Orders from May 28-30 are missing from the events table.'

assertions.name: task created in Data Platform with right title and priority
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE project_id=2 AND title='Backfill missing order events' AND priority='high'

assertions.name: no duplicate created
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE title='Backfill missing order events'

tasks.prompt: How many tasks across all projects are currently in 'todo' status? Reply with the count as a digit.

Good news: the vendor resolved ticket #4821, so the warehouse sync work is no longer blocked. Find that task, add a comment from Priya saying the vendor ticket is resolved, and move the task back to in_progress.

assertions.name: ETL task is in_progress
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id=5

assertions.name: Priya commented on the task
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE task_id=5 AND author_id=1

tasks.prompt: Devon used to own data-platform docs, so assign the 'Document the events schema' task to Devon. If that doesn't work for any reason, assign it to Priya instead and add a comment on the task (authored by Priya) explaining why she got it.

assertions.name: task ended up with Priya (Devon is suspended)
assertions.sql: SELECT assignee_id FROM tasks WHERE id=8

assertions.name: explanatory comment from Priya exists
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE task_id=8 AND author_id=1
